limitations: All V1 train, validation, and test sources are now seen; these are development diagnostics.
Head and case distributions are descriptive, not independent statistical samples.
Gain-box maxima relax the shared MLP to independent bounded gains; temporal-simplex maxima allow arbitrary concentration while preserving visual mass.
Zeroing conditioner/query is out of distribution and is a sensitivity probe, not a unique causal attribution.
Matched logged CE differences use native or stored zero-replay logits for the same sampled cases; no additional backbone or tail forward was executed.
